Q8245.reason: Hearing-aid power levels don't map to the bell's decibel level, so the absolute threshold in dB can't be determined from this data even though 70% yields 50% response.

Q8128.reason: Normal spirometry and no sputum rule out chronic bronchitis, and exercise-triggered cough in a non-smoker is more plausibly reflux-related than the other options, though neither B nor C fits well.

Q5479.reason: Conspiracy fails because the undercover agent never truly agreed, and the wife's renunciation after learning of the police sting may qualify as a renunciation defense to solicitation.
